# 2026-09-03; SCHEMA MIGRATED to the amended 8-column form by seat01, 2026-09-04, row
# icon-ladder-every-feature-in-isolation-with-variations). GOAL was the census (LADDER RECIPE step 1);
# walking (step 2) had ALREADY built 188 witnesses across 35 rungs before rung declaration started
# (earlier seat01/hq_B sessions, organically, per recipe point 3: "suite reds feed the ladder ... a
# construct no rung covers becomes the NEXT rung") -- rungs 36-37 were minted fresh since. This file's
# CONSTRUCT/FORMS split (below) is a re-reading of that same witness population, not a re-walk.
# CITATION: *The Icon Programming Language*, 3rd ed. (Griswold & Griswold, 1996) is the SCORE.md-cited
# authority; oracle is Icon v9.5.25a (`icont`/`iconx`, /home/resources/icon-master/bin/).
# ⭐ 2026-09-04 (seat01, ceo STEP 0 ruling on Lon: "Is Icon really at 90%? I do not believe it." -- the
# prior REFERENCE column was uniformly "oracle-observed", i.e. enumerated from the implementation, so
# 199/199 forms was by construction): THE BOOK IS NOW VENDORED AND REFERENCE IS REAL. It turns out the
# 2026-09-03 finding below ("no vendored copy exists") was checking the wrong place, not a dead end --
# the book is public domain (rights reverted to the authors) and hosted by its own maintainers, the
# University of Arizona Icon project: https://www2.cs.arizona.edu/icon/ftp/doc/lb1up.pdf (410pp, fetched
# and verified 2026-09-04). Vendored at SCRIP/refs/icon-book/{lb1up.pdf,lb1up.txt,SOURCE.txt} (refs/ is
# gitignored per the canonical-sources law -- re-fetch with the curl command in SOURCE.txt if missing).
# Every REFERENCE cell below citing a page number was checked against lb1up.txt (`pdftotext -layout`),
# most against the book's own formal Appendix D "Language Reference Manual" (functions/operators/keywords
# each with a numbered entry) or its own Index (App. after I) -- "verified:" in a cell means the quoted
# book text was read directly, not inferred from a chapter title. One row (string_return_procs, rung32)
# is flagged HONEST GAP rather than force-fit: it is a combination test with no single dedicated book
# section, and the citation says so instead of naming one anyway.
# ⛔ STILL OWED (real, substantial, not this session's work): the ceo ruling's deeper point -- FORMS
# should come FROM the book's list of forms, not just be labelled with a page after the fact. This
# session cited every row; it did NOT re-audit every row's FORMS column against the book the way rung12's
# sle/sgt gap was found in the prior session. That per-rung audit is next (see task ## NEXT) and is much
# faster now: App.D's per-construct entries (Functions p.275, Prefix p.295, Infix p.298, Other p.303,
# Keywords p.306, Control Structures p.311, Generators p.314) are grep-able in lb1up.txt for a title-page
# pattern like `grep -n '^abs(' refs/icon-book/lb1up.txt` to enumerate a construct's real form list.
# superseded finding, 2026-09-03 (seat01): UNLIKE Pascal's LADDER.tsv (a real vendored ISO text) or
# Prolog's (ISO 13211-1 + an ARCH doc), NO vendored copy of the Icon book exists under refs/ or
# /home/resources/icon-master (re-checked 2026-09-04: only man pages, icont.txt/icon.txt -- CLI driver
# docs, not language semantics -- and the IPL source tree; no book text). REFERENCE below is therefore
# uniformly "oracle-observed"... [FALSE, see above -- did not check the book's own project site]
# SCHEMA is hq_T's shared eight-column one (row ladder-forms-column-and-forms-check-every-declared-form-and-
# pair-has-a-witness): RUNG CONSTRUCT REFERENCE FORMS PAIRS WITNESS_ORIGIN STATUS NOTE. FORMS is |-separated,
# one entry per form/variation the construct exhibits (operator spelling, argument shape, boundary/failure
# case); PAIRS is |-separated lower-rung CONSTRUCT slugs for the combinations phase (sibling row
# icon-ladder-feature-combinations-after-isolation). Expected witness origins: isolation
# ladder__<rung>_<construct-prefix>_<form> (the prefix already live in ALL.csv, kept verbatim below) ·
# combinations ladder__<rung>_<construct>_with_<lower> (not yet minted -- sibling row's scope).
# ⭐ FORMS were derived MECHANICALLY from the real, oracle-graded witness population in
# corpus/tests/icon/ALL.csv (197 ladder__* origins, 2026-09-04), not hand-typed or guessed: each origin's
# trailing segment after its construct's declared prefix IS the form name, so every FORMS entry below
# names a witness that already exists and already passes (test_icon_ladder.sh --to 37: 394/394, this
# session, tree SCRIP 13ad1bcc corpus 39c4871eb -- see LEDGER). A MIXED rung (one RUNG number, several
# unrelated constructs, organic growth) is now split into one ROW PER CONSTRUCT, matching Prolog's
# precedent (rung01/rung02/rung13/rung14/rung15/rung19/rung35 below) instead of comma-joining constructs
# into one CONSTRUCT cell as the pre-migration file did.
# ⛔ PAIRS is a LIGHT FIRST PASS (one plausible lower-rung construct per row), not graded by this row's
# own DONE-WHEN (--phase isolation only) -- refine or extend for the combinations row, don't treat as final.
# ⛔ GAPS FOUND, NOT YET MINTED (this session ran out of turn budget before the mint/classify step -- see
# this row's task LEDGER for why, and corpus_suite_harness.py's CSV feature-column shape for what minting
# correctly requires): rung12 string_relop_size is missing the string <<= (le) and >> (strict gt) forms --
# only << (slt) >>= (sge) == (seq) ~== (sne) and size (*) exist today, so the six-operator family the
# CONSTRUCT cell already promises is 4/6, not 6/6. Next actor: mint ladder__rung12_strrelop_size_sle and
# _sgt (oracle-cut, corrupted-ref-proven, following the exact style of the five siblings already in
# ALL.icn/ALL.ref/ALL.csv), THEN add sle|sgt to that row's FORMS below.
# FORMAT: RUNG (matched by test_icon_ladder.sh's DONE-WHEN as ^rung[0-9]+ -- only ACTUALLY BUILT rungs may
# use this prefix, per hq_P's Pascal-ladder ruling: "this file's declared top tracks the real frontier, not
# a speculative plan") / CONSTRUCT / REFERENCE / FORMS / PAIRS / WITNESS_ORIGIN (the shared prefix, count in
# parens) / STATUS / NOTE.
# ⛔ STATUS "BUILT" means test_icon_ladder.sh graded every witness under that construct PASS in both modes.
# rung19/36/37 were BUILT-RED as of the pre-migration file (three real, filed defects: real to/by trailing
# decimal, insert() missing type-check, bal() missing type-check) -- RE-VERIFIED CLEAN this session (hq_B's
# cures landed and are in this tree; my own first measurement was against a STALE BINARY from before this
# session's `git pull`, corrected by rebuilding before trusting it -- see LEDGER) and are now BUILT.
# rung25 is a genuine numbering gap: no `ladder__rung25_*` origin exists in ALL.csv (unchanged from the
# pre-migration file; not chased this session either).
